import pyautogui; pyautogui.click(900, 300); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl','a'); pyautogui.write('Sub DoReorder
Dim n, oDoc, oComp, oEnum, oSheets, i
n = Array("ReadMe","Raw_data","Beans","Millet","Sorghum","Mkt Gotheye","Mkt Mangaize","Mkt Ouallam","Mkt Tera","Millet spatial integration")
oEnum = StarDesktop.Components.createEnumeration()
On Error Resume Next
Do While oEnum.hasMoreElements()
oComp = oEnum.nextElement()
If oComp.supportsService("com.sun.star.sheet.SpreadsheetDocument") Then oDoc = oComp
Loop
On Error Goto 0
oSheets = oDoc.Sheets
For i = 0 To UBound(n)
oSheets.moveByName(n(i), i)
Next i
oDoc.store()
End Sub', interval=0.01); pyautogui.press('f5')

import pyautogui; pyautogui.click(900, 220); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl','a'); pyautogui.press('delete'); pyautogui.write('Sub DoReorder
Dim n, oDoc, oComp, oEnum, oSheets, i
n = Array("ReadMe","Raw_data","Beans","Millet","Sorghum","Mkt Gotheye","Mkt Mangaize","Mkt Ouallam","Mkt Tera","Millet spatial integration")
oEnum = StarDesktop.Components.createEnumeration()
On Error Resume Next
Do While oEnum.hasMoreElements()
oComp = oEnum.nextElement()
If InStr(oComp.getURL(), ".xlsx") > 0 Then oDoc = oComp
Loop
On Error Goto 0
oSheets = oDoc.Sheets
For i = 0 To UBound(n)
oSheets.moveByName(n(i), i)
Next i
oDoc.store()
MsgBox "DONE " & oSheets.getByIndex(0).Name
End Sub', interval=0.01); pyautogui.press('f5')
